description: The marking scheme's own answer to 2021 OL Q5(d)(ii), as the State Examinations Commission set it: two dot and cross diagrams of an O₂ molecule, one drawn as two overlapping electron shells round the oxygen nuclei with two shared pairs where the shells overlap and two lone pairs on each outer shell, the other as O beside O with two shared pairs, dots and crosses, between them and two lone pairs on each atom; then two bond pairs shown // two lone pairs in valence shell of each oxygen shown (2 × 3), [Electrons in inner shell of oxygen need not be shown.] [Any electron can be represented by a dot or a cross.]

The marking scheme's own answer to 2024 HL Q5(b)(vi), drawn as the State Examinations Commission printed it. The question asks: Draw the shape of a p orbital. (29) The scheme requires: correct dumb-bell shape award 3 marks for drawing that shows overlapping dumb-bell shapes
